# Sporadic

> Sporadic is an iPhone and iPad app (also runs on Apple Vision Pro) that sends short exercise challenges at random times through your day, like "do 20 push-ups in the next hour." You pick a stack of exercises, and Sporadic picks the exercise, the rep count, and the time. Made by Perry Software LLC, run by Brendan Perry.

Sporadic is a supplement to working out, not a workout program. It is built for people who sit at a desk all day, work from home, or can't stick to a scheduled workout plan. No equipment is needed for any preset stack.

## How it works

- Pick one or more stacks. Each stack has a set of exercises, the days it runs, how many challenges a day, and how long you have to finish each one.
- A notification arrives at a random time (or a fixed time in schedule mode) telling you what to do.
- Do the exercise and mark it complete in the app. Finishing on time keeps your streak going. Missing one resets the streak, but lifetime stats are kept.
- Invite friends to a group to do the same challenges together.

## Stacks

- Get Up, Get Active (free): push-ups, squats, jumping jacks, crunches, lunges, burpees, planks, wall sits. Random, 2-4 a day, every day.
- Office Breaks (Pro): neck rolls, shoulder rolls, wrist stretch, stretch. 9am, 12pm and 2:30pm, Monday to Friday.
- Walk Reminders (Pro): walking. Random, 1-3 a day, 2-hour window to complete.
- Lower Body Boost (Pro): lower-body exercises.
- Wake Up Call (Pro): one challenge every morning.
- Daily Push-Ups (Pro): push-ups only, 2-4 a day, 1 hour to complete.
- Custom Stack (Pro): your own exercises, difficulty, and schedule.

## Pricing

- Free to start, with in-app purchases. The Get Up, Get Active stack is free; Sporadic Pro unlocks the other stacks and custom stacks.
